labelScope: support by supplied evidence bundle, not global truth or cluster relevance
selection: manual stratified behavioral cases; no claim of representative error prevalence
limitations: 30 paired evidence families are not 60 independent trials
multiple articles can share one event; eventGroupId is a minimum leakage grouping, not proof of independence
human-authored mutations are not naturally occurring model errors
labels are one non-blind Codex review, not multi-annotator gold
fully attributed statements are evaluated as reporting acts, not truth of attributed propositions
some compound negative cases have two explicitly enumerated error spans
